why: A bill introduction tagged (proc text) has a non-breaking space before the closing marker; the tagged row is trimmed, so it ends with the bill's own text and not with a space.
title: Criminal Law (Temporary Provisions) (Amendment) Bill
html:
[(proc text) "to amend the Criminal Law (Temporary Provisions) Act 1955", (proc text)]

[(proc text) presented by the Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) on behalf of the Minister for Home Affairs; read the First time; to be read a Second time on the next available Sitting of Parliament, and to be printed. (proc text)]
